# TQL sales soar amid AI, data centers and Trump immigration crackdown

 Alexander Coolidge

Cincinnati Enquirer

Aug. 12, 2026, 12:30 a.m. ET

- Total Quality Logistics expects annual sales to surpass $10 billion, driven by AI and data center growth.
- The company's co-CEO credits a Trump administration immigration crackdown with tightening trucking capacity and increasing rates.
- TQL has expanded with its first international office in Mexico and plans to hire over 1,000 new employees nationwide.

Greater Cincinnati’s largest private company, Total Quality Logistics, is getting even bigger, thanks to booming growth of artificial intelligence and data centers as well as Trump’s immigration crackdown.

The Union Township-based freight broker, which ships everything from groceries to rockets, expects its annual sales to climb above $10 billion for 2026, an increase of about a third, co-CEO Kerry Byrne told The Enquirer.

“AI is big: We are moving a lot of equipment to build those facilities and to equip them with tech that is needed. That is the hottest area right now,” Byrne said in an interview.

# Leicestershire logistics firm unveils major expansion after nearly 32% growth

28 Aug 2026 | by MHW Magazine Team | Logistics, News

Translink plans to turn its 66,000 sq ft Narborough site into a major indoor pallet sortation centre

A fast-growing Leicestershire logistics firm has announced a major leadership shake-up and plans for a huge new pallet sortation centre after recording almost 32% growth in two years.

Translink Express Logistics has made four senior appointments as the family-run business prepares to celebrate its 40th anniversary next summer.

Three existing employees have been promoted, with Lee Barrett becoming head of traffic, Dan Green taking on the newly created role of head of project management, and Shanice Walsh appointed head of operations.

Ryan Wallis has also joined the company as head of warehousing.

The new management team will take greater responsibility for the day-to-day running of the business, allowing its directors to focus more closely on longer-term growth plans.

The company said the new site creates a stronger Scotland-based network, enabling the business to provide faster lead times, greater capacity and greater flexibility for companies delivering products to customers across Scotland.

# NXHD/US group company completes new warehouse for the automotive industry in Ohio 

August 15, 2026 / Logistics facilities

NX Automotive Logistics America (NXAL), a subsidiary of NIPPON EXPRESS Holdings (HD), held a completion ceremony for its fourth warehouse on April 15th at its headquarters site in East Liberty, Ohio, USA.

 

Warehouse No. 4 has a total floor area of ​​16,762 m2.

With storage, export packaging, and warehouse operations capabilities, the facility will meet the growing demand for automotive-related logistics in the US Midwest, and leverage its proximity to production sites to strengthen its ability to provide customers with fast and stable logistics services.

Since its establishment in September 1989, NXAL has been based in Ohio, USA, providing logistics services primarily to the automotive industry, including production logistics support, warehousing and inventory management, kitting, export packaging, and packaging conversion.

results.author: Discover Burlington
results.text:
# Congratulations to Kwiksave Logistics Inc. on the grand opening of its new Burlington headquarters! · 2026-08-11T00:00:00+00:00

Congratulations to Kwiksave Logistics Inc. on the grand opening of its new Burlington headquarters!

The family-run business has officially opened the doors to its new 90,000 sq. ft. facility at 3100 Mainway, marking the largest investment in the company's history and a significant milestone in its continued growth.

From humble beginnings as a one-room operation in a Mississauga home to a 16,000 sq. ft. location on Harvester Road in 2017, Kwiksave Logistics has grown into a trusted final-mile logistics provider, distributing orders across the Greater Toronto Area.

Founded by Matthew and Maryam Sabet and now led by their children, Shariar, Rameen and Parisima, the company continues to build on a strong family legacy. During the ribbon cutting, the family reflected on their gratitude to their parents for laying the foundation for the business and shared their excitement for the opportunities Burlington offers as they continue to grow.

We're proud to celebrate this milestone and look forward to seeing Kwiksave Logistics continue to thrive in Burlington.

# Colonial Terminals Opens New Multimodal Breakbulk Facility on the Savannah River

September 8, 2026 Carriage Trade Public Relations 

Savannah, Ga., — Colonial Terminals announced the opening of Foundation 3, a new breakbulk facility on the Savannah River and the latest addition to its terminal network, expanding the company’s capabilities to serve customers moving cargo throughout the Southeast and beyond.

The approximately 25-acre terminal strengthens Colonial Terminals’ ability to provide integrated marine, rail, trucking and storage solutions while increasing breakbulk capacity in one of the nation’s fastest-growing logistics markets. With direct vessel access, Class I rail service through Norfolk Southern and convenient access to Interstate 16 and Interstate 95, Foundation 3 provides customers with greater flexibility and efficiency in moving cargo through the Port of Savannah region.
